description: First Nations Peoples Road Deaths in Australia is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Road Safety Data. This dataset contains deaths due to road vehicle traffic crashes and estimated populations for First Nations Peoples (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people) on Australian roads between 2012 to 2021. The data can be filtered by remoteness, age group, sex, jurisdiction, road user, vehicle and crash type. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Road Safety Data. Its tags are Crash, Fatality, First Nations Peoples, National, Remoteness Area. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-05-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
